tha-ap12:1.1: Ānanda.] Ārāmādvārā nikkhamma Padumuttaro mahāmuni / vassanto amataṃ vuṭṭhiṃ nibbāpesi mahājanaṃ. // //
tha-ap12:2.1: Satasahassāni vīrā chaḷabhiññā mahiddhikā / parivārenti sambuddhaṃ chāyā 'va anapāyinī. // //
tha-ap12:3.1: Hatthikkhandhagato āsiṃ setacchattam varuttamaṃ / sucārurūpaṃ disvāna vitti me udapajjatha. // //
tha-ap12:4.1: Oruyha hatthikkhandhamhā upagacchiṃ narāsabhaṃ / ratanāmayachattam me Buddhaseṭṭhassa dhārayiṃ. // //
tha-ap12:5.1: Mama saṅkappam aññāya Padumuttaro mahāisi / taṃ kathaṃ ṭhapayitvāna imā gāthā abhāsatha: // //
tha-ap12:6.1: ‘Yo so chattaṃ adhāresi soṇṇalaṅkārabhūsitaṃ / tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi; suṇotha mama bhāsato: // //
tha-ap12:7.1: Ito gantvā ayaṃ poso Tusitaṃ āvasissati / anubhossati sampattiṃ accharāhi purakkhato. // //
tha-ap12:8.1: Catutiṃsatikkhattuñ ca devarajjaṃ karissati / balādhipo aṭṭhasataṃ vasudhaṃ āvasissati. // //
tha-ap12:9.1: Aṭṭhapaññāsakkhattuñ ca cakkavatti bhavissati / padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ mahiyā kā*rayissati.* // //
tha-ap12:10.1: Kappasatasahassamhi Okkākakulasambhavo / Gotamo nāma gottena satthā loke bhavissati. // //
tha-ap12:11.1: Sakyānaṃ kulaketussa ñātibandhu bhavissati / Ānando nāma nāmena upaṭṭhāko mahesino. // //
tha-ap12:12.1: Ātā*pī ni*pako cāpi bāhusaccesu kovido / nivātavutti athaddho sabbapāṭhī bhavissati. // //
tha-ap12:13.1: Padhānapahitatto so upasanto nirūpadhi / sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat' anāsavo'. // //
tha-ap12:14.1: Santi āraññakā nāgā kuñjarā saṭṭhihāyanā / tidhāppabhinnā mātaṅgā-r-īsādantā urūḷhavā. // //
tha-ap12:15.1: Anekasatasahassā paṇḍitā pi mahiddhikā / sabbe te Buddhanāgassa na honti parivimhitā. // //
tha-ap12:16.1: Ādiyāme namassāmi majjhime atha pacchime / pasannacitto sumano Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃ. // //
tha-ap12:17.1: Ātāpī nipako cāpi sampajāno patissato / sotāpattiphalaṃ patto sekhabhūmisu kovido. // //
tha-ap12:18.1: Kappe 'to satasahasse yaṃ kammam abhinīhariṃ / tāhaṃ bhūmim anuppatto ṭhito saṅgama-m-ācalo. // //
tha-ap12:19.1: Sāgataṃ vata me āsi Buddhaseṭṭhassa santike / tisso vijjā anuppatto kataṃ Buddhassasāsanaṃ. // //
tha-ap12:20.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap12:21.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ānandatthero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
tha-ap12:24.1: Buddho Paccekasambuddho Sāriputto ca Kolito Kassapo Anuruddho ca Puṇṇathero Upāli ca.
tha-ap12:25.1: Koṇḍañño *ca* Piṇḍolo *ca* Revat' Ānanda paṇḍito chassatāni ca paññāsa gathāyo sabbapiṇḍitā.
